inboxUrl.title: Inbox address
inboxUrl.description: The page of your admin with the inbox widget, for example https://admin.shop.com/inbox. Alerts link to it with ?conversation=<id>, or with the id where you write {id}, for example https://admin.shop.com/chats?open={id}.

recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.description: E-mail addresses and international phone numbers (+ or 00 first; phones get WhatsApp or SMS), up to 20. The assigned person is added.

frequency.title: New message alerts
frequency.description: first_unanswered: once until staff reply or open the chat. every_message: on every visitor message.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: inbox.reply: every unblocked Accounts user whose role may reply in the inbox (needs the Accounts token). Empty = only the list above.

includePhone.title: Alerts carry the visitor's phone
includePhone.description: Adds the value {phone} (the phone the visitor signed in with or left) to the new message and Chat needs you alerts.
